hooks.command: perl -MJSON::PP -e 'local $/; my $d = decode_json(<STDIN>); my $f = $d->{tool_input}{file_path}; exit 0 unless defined $f && -f $f && $f =~ m{(\.(pas|asm|c|h|txt|md|bas)|/makefile)$}i; open my $i, "<:raw", $f or exit 0; my $t = <$i>; close $i; (my $n = $t) =~ s/\r?\n/\r\n/g; exit 0 if $n eq $t; open my $o, ">:raw", $f or exit 0; print $o $n;'
